story_title: As an Event Organiser, I want to create an event request containing my event requirements so that ConnectSphere has the information needed to begin planning my event.

acceptance_criteria.text: The Event Organiser can enter an event name and purpose.
The Event Organiser can enter an event description.
The Event Organiser can specify the proposed date and time.
The Event Organiser can specify expected attendance.
The Event Organiser can specify venue, accessibility, equipment and registration requirements.
The system validates required information before allowing submission.
A newly created incomplete request is identifiable as a draft.

test_cases.title: Organiser can enter an event name and purpose
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as Rachel Ng (rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123), a seeded Organiser. On the "New event request" page.
steps: Enter "Nusantara Product Launch 2026" into Event name
Enter "Regional product launch and press event" into Purpose
test_cases.test_data: Event name: Nusantara Product Launch 2026; Purpose: Regional product launch and press event
test_cases.expected_result:
The browser returns to "My events".
The new draft appears with the title "Nusantara Product Launch 2026". Reopening it shows Purpose still filled in as "Regional product launch and press event".

test_cases.title: Event name is required even when a purpose is entered
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123, on the "New event request" page.
steps: Enter "Regional product launch and press event" into Purpose
test_cases.test_data: Event name: "" (empty); Purpose: Regional product launch and press event
test_cases.expected_result: The page does not move on. A message "Give the event a name so you can find it again." appears under Event name.

test_cases.title: Organiser can enter and save an event description
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123, on the "New event request" page.
steps: Enter "Nusantara Product Launch 2026" into Event name
Enter "Press event with livestream and product demonstration area." into Description
From "My events", open the draft again
test_cases.test_data: Description: Press event with livestream and product demonstration area.
test_cases.expected_result: The draft is saved. Reopening it shows the Description field still reading "Press event with livestream and product demonstration area."

test_cases.title: Organiser can specify the proposed date and time
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123, on the "New event request" page, with Event name "Nusantara Product Launch 2026", Type of event "Exhibition", and Expected attendance 200 already filled in.
steps: Set Starts at to 5 Dec 2026, 9:00 AM
Set Ends at to 5 Dec 2026, 5:00 PM
test_cases.test_data: Starts at: 5 Dec 2026, 9:00 AM; Ends at: 5 Dec 2026, 5:00 PM
test_cases.expected_result: The request is created and immediately submitted. Its own page shows Starts at 5 Dec 2026, 9:00 AM, Ends at 5 Dec 2026, 5:00 PM, and status "Submitted".

test_cases.title: An end time before the start time is rejected
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123, on the "New event request" page, with Event name, Type of event and Expected attendance already filled in with valid values.
steps: Set Starts at to 5 Dec 2026, 5:00 PM
Set Ends at to 5 Dec 2026, 9:00 AM (earlier than Starts at)
test_cases.test_data: Starts at: 5 Dec 2026, 5:00 PM; Ends at: 5 Dec 2026, 9:00 AM
test_cases.expected_result: The page does not move on. A message "Ends at must be after starts at." appears under Ends at.

test_cases.title: A start date in the past is rejected when submitting
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123, on the "New event request" page, with Event name, Type of event and Expected attendance already filled in with valid values.
steps: Set Starts at to 1 Jan 2020, 9:00 AM (a past date)
Set Ends at to 1 Jan 2020, 5:00 PM
test_cases.test_data: Starts at: 1 Jan 2020, 9:00 AM (in the past)
test_cases.expected_result: The page does not move on. A message "The start date is in the past." appears under Starts at.

test_cases.title: Organiser can specify expected attendance
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123, on the "New event request" page, with Event name, Type of event, Starts at and Ends at already filled in with valid values.
test_cases.test_data: Expected attendance: 250
test_cases.expected_result: The request is created and submitted. Its own page shows Expected attendance as 250.

test_cases.title: Expected attendance of 0 is rejected
test_cases.preconditions: Same form state as TC07.
test_cases.test_data: Expected attendance: 0
test_cases.expected_result: The page does not move on. A message "Enter a whole number of people, at least 1." appears under Expected attendance.

test_cases.title: Expected attendance of 1 (the minimum) is accepted
test_cases.preconditions: Same form state as TC07.
test_cases.test_data: Expected attendance: 1
test_cases.expected_result: The request is created and submitted. Its own page shows Expected attendance as 1.

test_cases.title: Organiser can specify venue and accessibility requirements
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123, on the "New event request" page, with Event name, Type, dates and attendance already filled in with valid values.
steps: Tick "High-density WiFi" under "The venue must have"
test_cases.test_data: Venue requirement: High-density WiFi; Accessibility need: Wheelchair spaces
test_cases.expected_result: The request is created. Its own page lists both "High-density WiFi" and "Wheelchair spaces" among its requirements.

test_cases.title: Organiser can request equipment once the event has dates
test_cases.preconditions: On the "New event request" page with Starts at = 5 Dec 2026, 9:00 AM and Ends at = 5 Dec 2026, 5:00 PM already set.
steps: Choose "4K Portable Projector" in the Equipment list
test_cases.test_data: Equipment: 4K Portable Projector, quantity 2
test_cases.expected_result: The request is created with "4K Portable Projector" (quantity 2) listed under its equipment.

test_cases.title: Equipment cannot be requested before the event has dates
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123, on the "New event request" page, with Starts at and Ends at left blank.
test_cases.test_data: N/A — no dates entered
test_cases.expected_result: An info message "Add the event date and time above, then you can request equipment here." is shown in place of the equipment picker; there is no way to add an equipment row yet.

test_cases.title: Requesting the same equipment item twice is rejected
test_cases.preconditions: On the "New event request" page with Starts at = 5 Dec 2026, 9:00 AM and Ends at = 5 Dec 2026, 5:00 PM already set.
steps: Add an equipment row, choose "4K Portable Projector", quantity 2
Add a second equipment row, choose "4K Portable Projector" again, quantity 1
test_cases.test_data: Equipment: "4K Portable Projector" selected in two separate rows
test_cases.expected_result: The page does not move on. A message "Each item can only be requested once — change the quantity instead of adding a second row." is shown above the equipment rows.

test_cases.title: Organiser can enable registration with a capacity and window
test_cases.preconditions: On the "New event request" page with Starts at = 5 Dec 2026, 9:00 AM already set.
steps: Turn on "Attendees need to register for this event"
Set Registration opens to 1 Nov 2026, 12:00 AM
Set Registration closes to 1 Dec 2026, 12:00 AM
test_cases.test_data: Registration capacity: 300; Registration opens: 1 Nov 2026, 12:00 AM; Registration closes: 1 Dec 2026, 12:00 AM
test_cases.expected_result: The request is created with registration turned on, capacity 300, and the opens/closes dates shown exactly as entered.

test_cases.title: Registration capacity is required once registration is enabled
test_cases.preconditions: On the "New event request" page with registration toggled on and Registration capacity left empty.
steps: Turn on "Attendees need to register for this event"
test_cases.test_data: Registration capacity: "" (empty)
test_cases.expected_result: The page does not move on. A message "Enter how many attendees can register." appears under Registration capacity.

test_cases.title: Registration closing before it opens is rejected
test_cases.preconditions: On the "New event request" page with registration enabled and Registration capacity set to 300.
steps: Set Registration opens to 1 Dec 2026, 12:00 AM
Set Registration closes to 1 Nov 2026, 12:00 AM (before it opens)
test_cases.test_data: Registration opens: 1 Dec 2026, 12:00 AM; Registration closes: 1 Nov 2026, 12:00 AM
test_cases.expected_result: The page does not move on. A message "Registration closes at must be after it opens." appears under Registration closes.

test_cases.title: Registration cannot open on or after the event starts
test_cases.preconditions: On the "New event request" page with Starts at = 5 Dec 2026, 9:00 AM, registration enabled, Registration capacity set to 300.
steps: Set Registration opens to 5 Dec 2026, 9:00 AM (the same moment as the event start)
test_cases.test_data: Registration opens: 5 Dec 2026, 9:00 AM (equal to Starts at)
test_cases.expected_result: The page does not move on. A message "Registration must open before the event starts." appears under Registration opens.

test_cases.title: A fully completed request can be submitted
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123, on the "New event request" page.
steps: Enter "Nusantara Product Launch 2026" into Event name
Set Starts at to 5 Dec 2026, 9:00 AM and Ends at to 5 Dec 2026, 5:00 PM
test_cases.test_data: Event name, Type, Starts at, Ends at and Expected attendance all valid, as above
test_cases.expected_result: The browser moves to the request's own page, showing status "Submitted".

test_cases.title: Submit request is blocked when required fields are missing
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123, on the "New event request" page, with only Event name filled in.
steps: Enter "Nusantara Product Launch 2026" into Event name
Leave Type of event, Starts at, Ends at, and Expected attendance empty
test_cases.test_data: Event name only; Type, Starts at, Ends at, Expected attendance all blank
test_cases.expected_result: The page does not move on. Messages appear at once on Type of event ("Choose the type of event."), Starts at ("Enter when the event starts."), Ends at ("Enter when the event ends."), and Expected attendance ("Enter how many people you expect."); the cursor moves to the first field with a message.

test_cases.title: A newly created incomplete request is identifiable as a draft
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123, on the "New event request" page.
steps: Enter "Nusantara Product Launch 2026" into Event name only
test_cases.test_data: Event name: Nusantara Product Launch 2026 (no other fields)
test_cases.expected_result: The event appears under a "Drafts — not yet submitted" section with a "Draft" status badge, visually distinct from any submitted request.

test_cases.title: A freshly created event always starts life as a draft, even when every field is filled in
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123, on the "New event request" page.
steps: Fill in every field on the form: Event name, Type, Purpose, Description, dates, attendance, layout, facilities, equipment, registration
test_cases.test_data: A fully completed form, saved via "Save draft"
test_cases.expected_result: The event is created with a "Draft" badge, not "Submitted", regardless of how complete the form was — only clicking "Submit request" moves it out of Draft.
